title: メイショウドトウ登場！

text_block_list.text: I've joined Meisho Doto, a timid, clumsy Umamusume, to take on the Twinkle Series.
Her goal is to shine with confidence, just like her peer, T.M. Opera O.
While she enjoys the support of her friend, Matikanefukukitaru, she's criticized by her roommate, Air Shakur, for lacking sufficient stats.
Regardless, her refusal to give up is her biggest strength. Holding onto hope, Meisho Doto begins her racing journey.
